how_to_apply: Candidates must submit their applications online through the official careers portal of State Bank of India. No hard copy of the application or documents needs to be sent by post.
Visit the official SBI careers portal and navigate to the current openings page.
Locate the link for Specialist Cadre Officers recruitment under advertisement CRPD/SCO/2026-27/30.

Register online by entering basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password. The facility for editing saved application details is available up to three times only before final submission.
Fill in the online application form carefully with educational, professional, and personal details.

Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, biodata, resume, ID proof, age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, salary slips/Form-16, and other required documents in the prescribed format and size.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 750/- (exempted for SC/ST/PwBD) online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
Submit the completed application form and print a copy of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.
Photograph: Recent passport style colour picture (20 kb to 50 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 200 x 230 pixels, light-coloured or white background).
Signature: Signed on white paper with Black Ink pen (10 kb to 20 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 140 x 60 pixels; signatures in capital letters are not accepted).

Other Documents: Biodata, Resume, ID proof, Proof of Date of Birth, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate (if applicable), Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary Slip, and CTC negotiation sheet must be uploaded in PDF format on A4 size, with file size not exceeding 500 kb each.
Queries: For any queries, candidates can write via the "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" link available on the Bank's website (https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/post-your-query) or email [email protected].

content_sections.text: State Bank of India has announced 6 vacancies on a Fixed Term Employment basis. All vacancies belong to the Unreserved (UR) category.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for eligibility regarding educational qualification, age, and post-qualification work experience is 30.09.2026 . Candidates must be Indian citizens. Note on Experience: Training and teaching experience will not be counted towards eligibility. Individual contributor role experience does not count towards the mandatory senior leadership years. Specialization Certificate: In cases where the certificate of degree/diploma does not specify the field of specialization, the candidate must produce a certificate from the concerned university/college specifically mentioning the specialization. Important Eligibility Conditions and Restrictions: Candidates are not allowed to apply for more than one post. In case a candidate applies for more than one post, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and the application fee paid for the other registrations will stand forfeited. Candidates against whom there is/are adverse reports regarding character & antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply. Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, failing which their candidature will not be considered and travelling expenses will not be paid. In case of selection, candidates will be required to produce a proper discharge certificate from their current employer at the time of taking up the engagement. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Annual CTC is negotiable and will depend upon experience, current emoluments, and place of posting. The variable pay structure, depending on the performance score of the officer, is as follows: 99% to 100%: 100% of variable pay 97% to 98.99%: 90% of variable pay 94% to 96.99%: 80% of variable pay 90% to 93.99%: 70% of variable pay Below 90%: Nil Tenure and Contract Terms: Engagement is on a Fixed Term Employment basis for 3 years, which may be renewed for a further period of 2 years at the discretion of the Bank at mutually agreed terms and conditions (total engagement period not to exceed 5 years). The contract can be terminated by giving 3 months' notice from either side or payment/surrender of 3 months' compensation amount in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Job Profile and Key Responsibilities: Lead the implementation and operations of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, and parsing tools to improve operational efficiency and mitigate risk. Design and implement big data scalable workflow systems including Enterprise AI Platform for generative and agentic AI. Deliver AI solutions at scale with operational and analytical integrations including Cloudera Data Lakehouse and enterprise API platforms. Deliver new functionality for internal production and client delivery platforms. Collaborate with Product Management, Business, Quality Assurance, Data Operation, and IT Infrastructure. Oversee business collaboration via permanent control towers for AI/data products and ensure seamless integration into formal business processes. Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory norms and align with Bank governance standards and top management directives. Oversee independent model validation team and evaluate ongoing risk and performance in models. Job Profile and Key Responsibilities: Lead the Bank's risk and operational analytics function and establish an enterprise-wide roadmap across Risk, Compliance, Business, and Operations. Lead design, development, validation, implementation, and operations of AI/ML models for early-warning systems, collections, fraud prevention, operational risk, financial risk, and process optimization. Integrate analytical models and decision engines into core banking, loan origination, and operational workflows via enterprise data and API platforms. Establish human-in-the-loop controls, override mechanisms, audit trails, and escalation procedures for material decisions. Prioritise high-impact use cases based on loss reduction, regulatory importance, customer impact, efficiency, and feasibility. Drive responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI for risk intelligence, document analysis, and operational decision support. Job Profile and Key Responsibilities: Lead the Bank's AI governance and compliance function across ML, generative AI, and agentic AI. Develop, maintain, and enforce AI governance policies, standards, risk-classification methodologies, and control frameworks. Oversee independent validation, periodic review, and governance controls for material models and AI-enabled systems. Ensure compliance with applicable RBI directions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, and information security norms. Coordinate AI risk assessments, privacy impact assessments, security reviews, and approval processes before production deployment. Oversee third-party AI governance, vendor due diligence, contractual safeguards, and data-use restrictions. Convene or support governance committees and coordinate regulatory inspections and audit closures. Job Profile and Key Responsibilities: Lead data engineering, model application development, and AI Ops functions to deliver scalable, secure data and AI pipelines. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation. Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates. Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent. CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process. Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order. Travelling Allowance for Interview: Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting will be reimbursed the cost of travelling by Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route in India as follows: GM & Chief AI officer and all three DGM posts (Sl. No. 1 to 4): Reimbursement of actual Air Fare (Economy Class). AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect (Sl. No. 5 & 6): Reimbursement of Air Fare up to Rs. 15,000/- (Total for both sides) or actual fare, whichever is lower. Note: In case a candidate called for interview is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification, Experience, etc.), he/she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled to reimbursement of any travelling expenses.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under SBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for Specialist Cadre Officers on a Fixed Term Employment basis, with 1 post for each of the 6 advertised roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration of application and payment of fees is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates for GM and DGM posts require B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in CS/IT/Electronics/ECE/EEE or equivalent, or M.Sc/MA/M.Stat/MCA. Architect posts require a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, AI, Business Administration, or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: As on 30.09.2026, the age limit is 40 to 55 years for GM & Chief AI Officer, 35 to 50 years for DGM posts, and 30 to 45 years for AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for SBI Specialist Cadre Officers?
faq.answer: The annual CTC upper range is Rs. 160.00 Lacs for GM & Chief AI Officer, Rs. 120.00 Lacs for DGM posts, and Rs. 90.00 Lacs for AI Architect posts, bifurcated into 90% fixed pay and 10% variable pay.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee and intimation charge is Rs. 750/- for General, EWS, and OBC candidates, while SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the SBI official careers portal, complete the registration form, upload the required scanned documents and photographs, and pay the fee by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection consists of shortlisting based on qualification and experience, followed by a 100-mark interview (including a 10-minute presentation for GM and DGM posts), and CTC negotiation.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job with State Bank of India?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on a Fixed Term Employment contract for an initial period of 3 years, renewable for up to 2 additional years at the discretion of the Bank, not exceeding 5 years in total.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Candidates are not allowed to apply for more than one post; if a candidate applies for multiple posts, only the last valid completed application will be retained and previous fees stand forfeited.
